info.title: Trama Workflow Orchestrator API
info.description: HTTP API for registering workflow definitions, running workflows, checking status, retrying failed executions, and waking sleeping executions.

get.description: Fails only when this process's work consumer has made no progress for runtime.livenessStallMillis (default 2 min), so an orchestrator restarts a stuck process.

503.description: Not ready: shutting_down, redis_unreachable, consumer_stalled (no claim progress for 3x the claim lease), or a membership problem

get.description: Newest first, limited to executions started in the last 30 days.

get.summary: List step results of an execution
get.description: Forward (UP), compensation (DOWN), CALLBACK, SWITCH, SPLIT and JOIN results in execution order.

200.description: Step results (empty when the execution is unknown)

get.summary: List outbound HTTP calls of an execution
get.description: One entry per attempt, with the rendered request and the response.

200.description: Step calls (empty when the execution is unknown)

409.description: Saga is not in FAILED status, or its definition is not stored

post.summary: Wake a sleeping saga execution early

409.description: Saga is not in SLEEPING state

post.summary: Deliver an async callback to a waiting node
post.description: Called by the external service with the URL and token injected as {{runtime.callback.url}} / {{runtime.callback.token}}. The body is evaluated against the node's callback.successWhen / failureWhen (as callback.body).

202.description: Callback accepted (the saga resumes, or compensates when the callback signals failure)

410.description: Token expired or execution no longer waiting

get.summary: Get stored saga definition by id

put.summary: Create stored saga definition with explicit id
put.description: This endpoint inserts only; it returns 409 if the id or name/version already exists.

get.summary: Get stored saga definition by name and version

post.summary: Run a stored saga definition by name and version

400.description: Invalid parameters or invalid stored definition

phase.description: UP, DOWN, CALLBACK, SWITCH, SPLIT or JOIN.

error.description: Transport error when no response was received.

status.description: Execution status persisted by repository, e.g. IN_PROGRESS, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CORRUPTED.

definition.description: v1 (steps-based) or v2 (node-graph) definition, auto-detected by the presence of `nodes`.

SagaDefinitionCreateRequest.description: v1 (steps-based) or v2 (node-graph) definition, auto-detected by the presence of `nodes`.

SagaDefinitionV2.description: Node-graph definition format. Branching, async callbacks, sleeps, and parallel split/join are expressed as a graph of nodes instead of a linear step list.

entrypoint.description: Id of the node execution starts at.

next.description: Id of the next node. Omit or null on the last node of a branch/definition.

SwitchNodeDefinition.description: Evaluates JSON Logic cases against the payload/prior results and routes to the matching target node, without making an HTTP call.

default.description: Id of the node to route to when no case matches.

SleepNodeDefinition.description: Pauses the execution for durationMillis (chunked internally to avoid a single very long delay) before continuing at next.

SplitNodeDefinition.description: Fans out into independent sub-executions, one per branch entry node id, each running the full retry/compensation pipeline on its own. Paired with exactly one join node via `join`.

branches.description: Ids of the node each branch starts at.

join.description: Id of the join node that barriers on this split's branches.

JoinNodeDefinition.description: Barrier that waits for every branch spawned by its owning split node to reach a terminal state, then continues at next.

next.description: Omit or null to terminate the definition at this join.

acceptedStatusCodes.description: For async task nodes: status codes on the initial fire-and-pause response that count as accepted (default 2xx).

when.description: JSON Logic expression evaluated against the template context.

successStatusCodes.description: If omitted, the server applies verb-based defaults.

TemplateString.description: Template string accepted as either raw JSON string or wrapped object.
